head.prose:
Maintains a single authoritative registry record for a health worker from pre-service education through registration, active employment, payroll reconciliation and exit from the active workforce.

![Health worker lifecycle and registry record maintenance (HRH-BP-01)](media/bp-hrh-bp-01-lifecycle-maintenance.svg)

- `Lane_BP01_TrainingRegistrar` — **Training institution registrar** ([`pers:training-institution-registrar`](#pers:training-institution-registrar))
- `Lane_BP01_RegistrationOfficer` — **Registration officer (regulatory body)** ([`pers:registration-officer`](#pers:registration-officer))
- `Lane_BP01_EmployerHR` — **Employer or facility HR manager** ([`pers:employer-hr-manager`](#pers:employer-hr-manager))
- `Lane_BP01_Payroll` — **Payroll system** ([`pers:system-payroll`](#pers:system-payroll))

| Step ID | Lane (persona) | Activity | Linked requirement / decision table | Outline basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Task_BP01_01` | [`pers:training-institution-registrar`](#pers:training-institution-registrar) | Record student indexing, pre-service education completion and graduation confirmation. | [`prose:ch04-health-worker-lifecycle`](#prose:ch04-health-worker-lifecycle) | 4.3, 13.2 |

| `Task_BP01_03` | [`pers:employer-hr-manager`](#pers:employer-hr-manager) | Record recruitment, appointment and facility posting against the worker's registry identifier. | [`freq:FR-REC-02`](#freq:FR-REC-02), [`freq:FR-LC-01`](#freq:FR-LC-01) | 4.3, 7.3 |
| `Task_BP01_04` | [`pers:system-payroll`](#pers:system-payroll) | Reconcile payroll records periodically against active registry records to flag duplicate or ghost entries. | [`prose:ch04-strategic-uses`](#prose:ch04-strategic-uses) | 1.2, 4.4, 13.3 |
| `Task_BP01_05` | [`pers:registration-officer`](#pers:registration-officer) | Record career progression, specialty qualification, CPD and periodic licence renewal. | [`freq:FR-LC-01`](#freq:FR-LC-01), `dt:hrh-dt-02-lifecycle-status-transition` | 4.3, 7.3 |

head.prose:
Registers and licenses a newly graduated health worker by verifying pre-service qualification with the training institution, checking foundational identity and deduplication rules, and issuing an authoritative registration and licence to practise.

![Register and license a new graduate (HRH-BP-02)](media/bp-hrh-bp-02-register-and-license-graduate.svg)

- `Lane_BP02_RegistrationOfficer` — **Registration officer (regulatory body)** ([`pers:registration-officer`](#pers:registration-officer))
- `Lane_BP02_TrainingRegistrar` — **Training institution registrar** ([`pers:training-institution-registrar`](#pers:training-institution-registrar))
- `Lane_BP02_NationalId` — **National identity system** ([`pers:system-national-id`](#pers:system-national-id))

| Step ID | Lane (persona) | Activity | Linked requirement / decision table | Outline basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Task_BP02_01` | [`pers:health-worker`](#pers:health-worker) | Submit application for initial registration and licence to practise with identity and training details. | [`scen:register-and-license-new-graduate`](#scen:register-and-license-new-graduate) | 5.2, 20.1 |
| `Task_BP02_02` | [`pers:training-institution-registrar`](#pers:training-institution-registrar) | Confirm graduation and awarded qualification directly as primary source. | [`freq:FR-REC-01`](#freq:FR-REC-01) | 5.2, 13.2, 20.1 |
| `Task_BP02_03` | [`pers:system-national-id`](#pers:system-national-id) | Verify national identity number where available and lawful. | [`freq:FR-ID-01`](#freq:FR-ID-01) | 7.1, 13.2 |
| `Task_BP02_04` | [`pers:registration-officer`](#pers:registration-officer) | Run deduplication check ([`freq:FR-ID-02`](#freq:FR-ID-02)) and evaluate registration eligibility rules (`dt:hrh-dt-01-registration-eligibility`). | [`freq:FR-ID-01`](#freq:FR-ID-01), [`freq:FR-ID-02`](#freq:FR-ID-02), `dt:hrh-dt-01-registration-eligibility` | 7.1, 7.2 |
| `Task_BP02_05` | [`pers:registration-officer`](#pers:registration-officer) | Create or link persistent HWR identifier, record registration and active licence, and issue verifiable credential. | [`freq:FR-REC-01`](#freq:FR-REC-01), [`freq:FR-REC-02`](#freq:FR-REC-02), [`freq:FR-VER-03`](#freq:FR-VER-03) | 7.1, 7.2, 7.4 |
| `Task_BP02_06` | [`pers:registration-officer`](#pers:registration-officer) | Hold application for manual duplicate resolution or notify applicant of missing attestation/ineligibility. | [`freq:FR-ID-02`](#freq:FR-ID-02), `dt:hrh-dt-01-registration-eligibility` | 7.1 |
| `Task_BP02_07` | [`pers:health-worker`](#pers:health-worker) | Receive registration certificate and portable verifiable licence credential. | [`freq:FR-VER-03`](#freq:FR-VER-03) | 5.2, 20.1 |

*ArchiMate (dpi-h-ra 0.2.0):* [Academic & Training Institutions](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/archimate/0.2.0/elements/id-82fc8a35ade94ff3a02acc9194490fc8.jsonld) (`BusinessRole`); [Licensing Bodies](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/archimate/0.2.0/elements/id-63c448813aea4067bb68281f7926fd2b.jsonld) (`BusinessRole`); [National ID Government Provider](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/archimate/0.2.0/elements/id-10058e61afa048128fdb46dc0bcb884c.jsonld) (`BusinessRole`); [Credential & License](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/archimate/0.2.0/elements/id-3bc59974bc1e4e5d8e795cdc1606587e.jsonld) (`ApplicationFunction`); [ALL High Level - Health Workforce](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/archimate/0.2.0/views/id-19be800d18a34a618d6e1955cf58e956.jsonld) (`View`).

head.prose:
Renews a health worker's licence to practise based on continuing professional development and good-standing rules, and serves tiered status verification responses to members of the public and point-of-care clinical systems.

![Renew a licence and verify registration status (HRH-BP-03)](media/bp-hrh-bp-03-renew-licence-and-verify-status.svg)

**Swimlanes (one lane per role):**

- `Lane_BP03_HealthWorker` — **Health worker** ([`pers:health-worker`](#pers:health-worker))
- `Lane_BP03_RegistrationOfficer` — **Registration officer (regulatory body)** ([`pers:registration-officer`](#pers:registration-officer))
- `Lane_BP03_Public` — **Member of the public** ([`pers:member-of-public`](#pers:member-of-public))
- `Lane_BP03_EMR` — **Electronic medical record** ([`pers:system-emr`](#pers:system-emr))

| Step ID | Lane (persona) | Activity | Linked requirement / decision table | Outline basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Task_BP03_01` | [`pers:health-worker`](#pers:health-worker) | Submit licence renewal application and continuing professional development (CPD) completion records. | [`scen:renew-licence`](#scen:renew-licence), [`freq:FR-LC-01`](#freq:FR-LC-01) | 5.2, 7.3 |
| `Task_BP03_02` | [`pers:registration-officer`](#pers:registration-officer) | Evaluate CPD completion, licence expiry and disciplinary standing via `dt:hrh-dt-02-lifecycle-status-transition`. | [`freq:FR-LC-01`](#freq:FR-LC-01), [`freq:FR-LC-02`](#freq:FR-LC-02), `dt:hrh-dt-02-lifecycle-status-transition` | 7.3 |
| `Task_BP03_03` | [`pers:registration-officer`](#pers:registration-officer) | Record renewed licence validity period and issue updated digital verifiable credential. | [`freq:FR-LC-01`](#freq:FR-LC-01), [`freq:FR-VER-03`](#freq:FR-VER-03) | 7.3, 7.4 |
| `Task_BP03_04` | [`pers:registration-officer`](#pers:registration-officer) | Transition licence status to lapsed, suspended or revoked with timestamped audit trail and notify connected systems. | [`freq:FR-LC-02`](#freq:FR-LC-02), `dt:hrh-dt-02-lifecycle-status-transition` | 7.3, 20.2 |
| `Task_BP03_05` | [`pers:member-of-public`](#pers:member-of-public) | Check practitioner registration and active licence status on the public lookup channel. | [`scen:verify-status`](#scen:verify-status), [`freq:FR-VER-01`](#freq:FR-VER-01) | 5.2, 7.4, 12.1 |
| `Task_BP03_06` | [`pers:system-emr`](#pers:system-emr) | Query the registry via API at the point of care to confirm practitioner identity and prescribing/clinical authorization. | [`scen:verify-status`](#scen:verify-status), [`freq:FR-VER-02`](#freq:FR-VER-02) | 4.4, 7.4, 20.2 |
| `Task_BP03_07` | [`pers:registration-officer`](#pers:registration-officer) | Apply tiered disclosure rules (`dt:hrh-dt-03-verification-and-access-response`) and return public or authorized status payload. | [`freq:FR-VER-01`](#freq:FR-VER-01), [`freq:FR-VER-02`](#freq:FR-VER-02), `dt:hrh-dt-03-verification-and-access-response` | 7.4, 12.1 |

*ArchiMate (dpi-h-ra 0.2.0):* [Licensing Bodies](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/archimate/0.2.0/elements/id-63c448813aea4067bb68281f7926fd2b.jsonld) (`BusinessRole`); [Vendor EHR Product](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/archimate/0.2.0/elements/id-3bd1011d76c843fa860255f00a6aa68f.jsonld) (`ApplicationComponent`); [Patients](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/archimate/0.2.0/elements/id-a2320dbc07e6450b94f3f0f3e03bb877.jsonld) (`BusinessRole`); [Credential & License](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/archimate/0.2.0/elements/id-3bc59974bc1e4e5d8e795cdc1606587e.jsonld) (`ApplicationFunction`); [ALL High Level - Health Workforce](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/archimate/0.2.0/views/id-19be800d18a34a618d6e1955cf58e956.jsonld) (`View`).

head.prose:
Governs inter-institutional data-sharing agreements and access tiers through the multi-stakeholder steering committee, enforces routine data quality and deduplication audits through the registry custodian, and resolves health worker record-correction requests with the authoritative source.

![Registry governance, data-sharing approval and record correction (HRH-BP-06)](media/bp-hrh-bp-06-governance-and-stewardship-review.svg)

**Swimlanes (one lane per role):**

- `Lane_BP06_GovernanceBody` — **Registry governance body (steering committee)** (`pers:registry-governance-body`)
- `Lane_BP06_HealthWorker` — **Health worker** ([`pers:health-worker`](#pers:health-worker))
- `Lane_BP06_Custodian` — **Registry operator and data custodian** (`pers:registry-custodian`)
- `Lane_BP06_RegistrationOfficer` — **Registration officer (regulatory body)** ([`pers:registration-officer`](#pers:registration-officer))

| Step ID | Lane (persona) | Activity | Linked requirement / decision table | Outline basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Task_BP06_01` | `pers:registry-governance-body` | Review and approve inter-institutional data-sharing agreements, field-level authoritative source matrix, and tiered disclosure policy. | [`prose:ch06-institutions`](#prose:ch06-institutions), [`prose:ch06-legal-foundations`](#prose:ch06-legal-foundations), `dt:hrh-dt-03-verification-and-access-response` | 6.1, 6.2, 12.1 |
| `Task_BP06_02` | `pers:registry-custodian` | Enforce role-based access rules ([`nfreq:NFR-01`](#nfreq:NFR-01)), maintain provenance and audit logs ([`freq:FR-REC-03`](#freq:FR-REC-03)), and run periodic deduplication and completeness reviews ([`freq:FR-ID-02`](#freq:FR-ID-02)). | [`freq:FR-ID-02`](#freq:FR-ID-02), [`freq:FR-REC-03`](#freq:FR-REC-03), [`nfreq:NFR-01`](#nfreq:NFR-01) | 6.3, 7.1, 7.2, 12.2 |
| `Task_BP06_03` | [`pers:health-worker`](#pers:health-worker) | Inspect own registry record and submit a request to correct inaccurate or outdated attributes. | [`prose:ch06-data-stewardship`](#prose:ch06-data-stewardship) | 5.1, 6.3, 12.3 |
| `Task_BP06_04` | `pers:registry-custodian` | Log the correction request and route it to the designated authoritative source custodian for the disputed data element. | [`prose:ch06-data-stewardship`](#prose:ch06-data-stewardship), [`freq:FR-REC-03`](#freq:FR-REC-03) | 6.3, 7.2 |
| `Task_BP06_05` | [`pers:registration-officer`](#pers:registration-officer) | Verify primary-source evidence and update the authoritative registration or qualification field with full audit trail. | [`freq:FR-REC-01`](#freq:FR-REC-01), [`freq:FR-REC-03`](#freq:FR-REC-03) | 6.3, 7.2, 12.3 |
| `Task_BP06_06` | `pers:registry-custodian` | Record decision rationale when a change cannot be substantiated and notify the health worker of the outcome and appeal channel. | [`prose:ch06-data-stewardship`](#prose:ch06-data-stewardship), [`freq:FR-REC-03`](#freq:FR-REC-03) | 6.3, 12.3 |

*ArchiMate (dpi-h-ra 0.2.0):* [Owner](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/archimate/0.2.0/elements/id-99b92fe529e94fcd8ceac04cb16aefd7.jsonld) (`BusinessRole`); [Logical Information Model Maintainer](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/archimate/0.2.0/elements/id-8b80d28cdd48418480cee878af495ac3.jsonld) (`BusinessRole`); [Ministry of Health](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/archimate/0.2.0/elements/id-1c5c0bc9234e4282b654dbc71b9da706.jsonld) (`BusinessRole`); [Licensing Bodies](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/archimate/0.2.0/elements/id-63c448813aea4067bb68281f7926fd2b.jsonld) (`BusinessRole`); [Metadata Registry Governance](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/archimate/0.2.0/views/id-f7a5524bbac84f1a9cf424754750819d.jsonld) (`View`).
